description: Local-first AI code search, chat and memory for your whole workspace. Search by meaning across repositories, get answers from your own LLM with sources, and share context with MCP agents.
welcome.noFolder:
Brokspace works on the folder you open: one repository or a folder of several.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
welcome.noBrok:
Brokspace runs on brok, its local CLI, which was not found. Install it, or set **brokspace.brokPath**.
[How to Install brok](command:brokspace.installHelp)
[Check Again](command:brokspace.refresh)
welcome.outdated:
This extension needs a newer brok. Run `brok upgrade` in a terminal, then check again.
[Check Again](command:brokspace.refresh)
welcome.setup:
Set up Brokspace here: it indexes this folder for search, finds your local LLM and connects your coding agents. The search model is downloaded once (about 140 MB).
[Set Up Workspace](command:brokspace.setup)
welcome.error:
Brokspace could not read this workspace.
[Run Doctor](command:brokspace.doctor)
[Report a Bug](command:brokspace.reportBug)
welcome.memory:
Nothing remembered yet. Decisions, facts and your chats with Brokspace show up here, and in every answer.
[Remember Something](command:brokspace.remember)
welcome.links:
Working on a service that calls another one? Link it: questions and searches then know both, and their memories.
[Link a Workspace](command:brokspace.addLink)
welcome.shards:
Shards are small programs and skill packs that react to your workspace.
[Install a Shard](command:brokspace.installShard)
chat.description: Answers about this workspace from your own LLM, through brok, with sources
chat.skill: Run a skill: `/skill tdd add a priority field`
chat.search: Search the workspace by meaning or by name
chat.remember: Remember a decision or a fact for later sessions
config.brokPath: Path of the `brok` executable. Empty: the installer's folder, Cargo's, Homebrew's, then `PATH`.
config.mcp: Offer `brok mcp` (Brokspace search and memory) to the editor's AI and agent mode. Skipped when `.vscode/mcp.json` already declares it.
config.saveSessions: Save each Brokspace chat as a memory, so later chats build on it (also `memory.sessions` in `brok.yml`).
config.statusBar: Show Brokspace's state and model in the status bar.
